text:
maya: heads-up — planned deploy tonight 22:00 UTC. runtime v2.3.0 (kv-caching + kernel switch), router v1.9.1, api v4.5.0, console v3.0.0. need to confirm cross-service pins and rollback triggers.
henry: noted. main risk is api schema change in 4.5.0 — console needs that change for structured logs. can we hold console if api is delayed?
maya: yes, console can be rolled independently. runtime+router+api should go together for performance signals. console can be canaried later in same window.
san: for runtime we switched kernel selector behavior; if we see latency > 150ms p95 on canary, rollback runtime only. is that OK?
henry: agreed. runtime rollback criteria: p95 increase > 25% vs baseline OR error-rate spike > 0.5%. runtime team to monitor.
anya: router change updates sticky-session hashing — if 5xx rate jumps in router metrics, we should pin back to v1.8.x. pinning plan?
maya: plan: deploy-bot will do staged rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 70% -> 100% with 10m steady windows. manual hold at each stage. rollback button enabled for each service.
lina: deploy-bot: preparing rollout groups. please confirm model-of-record mapping for the API routes (chat vs embeddings) — will we route embeddings to a fallback variant during rollout?
maya: yes — routing policy: embeddings -> api v4.5.0 only for 25%+ traffic; below that route to v4.4.9 fallback. this avoids regression for embedding customers.
sam: what about KV cache warmup for runtime? can we pre-warm the most common prefixes for canary nodes?
maya: runtime team will seed the top 500 prefixes in canary before 1st traffic shift. script: `./tools/seed_kv_prefixes --list top500.txt --target canary`
henry: release notes segment for ops: include rollback commands and monitoring dashboards. I'll add console-specific note about schema toggle `FEATURE_STRUCT_LOGS=false` in console-config.
deploy-bot: release plan submitted by maya. Services: runtime@2.3.0, router@1.9.1, api@4.5.0, console@3.0.0. Change window: 22:00-23:30 UTC. Canary steps: 5/25/70/100.
anya: can we set a guardrail to stop at 25% if any region shows >10% p50 increase?
maya: yes — added region-level guardrail. ops: we will pause and triage if triggered.
sam: who is oncall for runtime and router tonight?
lina: runtime oncall: sam, fallback: anya. router oncall: henry, fallback: clara.
henry: I'll post the quick rollback playbook in the thread (commands + dashboards) before the window.
maya: action items: henry posts rollback playbook, sam seeds prefixes, deploy-bot schedule set to 22:00 utc, lina to verify canary groups. everyone ack here.
henry: ack :thumbsup:
sam: ack
anya: ack
lina: ack
maya: OK launching preflight in 30m — will update if anything blocks.
deploy-bot: preflight checks passing: infra quotas OK, canary groups created, seed job queued.
maya: if preflight stays green we'll proceed with first shift at 22:00. thanks all.
